::: {#exr-bikeshare-ratio}

#### Interpret the temperature coefficient

Use the [Poisson regression model](poisson-regression.qmd#def-poisson-regression) of @exr-bikeshare-fit.
Consider two hours with the same `workingday` and `weathersit`,
one with `temp` $0.1$ higher than the other.

::: {.callout-tip}

#### Hint

The [Poisson regression model](poisson-regression.qmd#def-poisson-regression) of @exr-bikeshare-fit has no interactions or transformations involving `temp`,
so @thm-poisson-rate-ratio applies.

:::

[Estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) the [rate ratio](poisson-regression.qmd#def-rate-ratio) comparing the warmer hour with the cooler one.

:::
